title: Area under a curve: one thin strip
back: Strip of height $y$ and width $dx$ has area $y\,dx$. Adding the strips from $x=a$ to $x=b$ gives $\int_a^by\,dx$.

title: Area of an ellipse by symmetry
back: Find the first-quadrant area with $y=\dfrac ba\sqrt{a^2-x^2}$ and multiply by 4. Result $\pi ab$; here $a=4$, $b=3$, so $12\pi$.

title: A region with a corner
back: $y=\lvert x+3\rvert$ from $x=-6$ to $x=0$: split at the corner $x=-3$. Two triangles of area $\dfrac92$ each: total 9 sq. units.

title: Circle, line and x-axis
back: Split at the intersection $(\sqrt3,1)$: under the line from 0 to $\sqrt3$, under the circle from $\sqrt3$ to 2. Total $\dfrac\pi3$ sq. units.

title: Area with vertical strips
legend: y = height of the strip, from the curve
a, b = x-limits of the region
back: Use when the region stands on the $x$-axis.

title: Area with horizontal strips
legend: x = length of the strip, in terms of y
c, d = y-limits of the region
back: Use when the region is bounded by the $y$-axis, for example $x^2=4y$ between $y=2$ and $y=4$.

title: Area of the circle x² + y² = a²
back: First quadrant × 4. The integral needs $\int\sqrt{a^2-x^2}\,dx$; at the limits only the $\sin^{-1}$ term survives.

title: Area of an ellipse
back: $4\cdot\dfrac ba\int_0^a\sqrt{a^2-x^2}\,dx$. Show the integration; the formula alone earns only the last mark.

title: Parabola and its latus rectum
back: $2\int_0^a2\sqrt a\sqrt x\,dx$. The factor 2 is for the half below the axis.

title: Area under y = sin x
back: From $0$ to $2\pi$ the area is 4, not 0: the lower loop is counted with its modulus.
